artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in profile view, with their head turned to the left. The sketch emphasizes the facial features such as the nose, cheekbone, and mouth. The hair is wavy and styled towards the back of the head. The focus is on the figure's contour and hair, with no clothing details shown. The background is a light, plain surface, possibly the paper texture. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the hands of the figure. The sketch is monochrome, created with pencil or graphite on textured paper.

artworks.title: Study of Hands
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows detailed sketches of hands. One hand has fingers outstretched in the upper left corner. Another hand below has slightly curled fingers, while a third hand to the right also shows curled fingers. The sketches are meticulously done with attention to light and shadow. The background is a simple, plain light beige.

artworks.title: Dead Bird
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: There is a bird with a yellow chest and blue-tinted wings lying on its side on a dark brown surface. The bird's head faces left, its legs stretch towards the right, and a small feather and a sphere-like object lie nearby at the bottom.

artworks.title: Dead Yellow-breasted Bird in Autumn Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: This is a painting of a landscape scene featuring a bird. The artwork captures a scene with earthy tones and soft brushwork, depicting a tranquil scene where a bird lies on a textured ground composed of warm browns and blues. The lines suggest a natural setting, enhanced by a blend of muted pinks, browns, and blues for the sky. The image is divided into two portions by tall, thin branches with occasional leaves. There is an air of stillness and simplicity.

artworks.title: Flowers in a Pitcher
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: This painting shows a white ceramic jug filled with a bouquet of wide green leaves and a few delicate pink and white flowers. The jug is decorated with thin blue lines creating floral patterns. It is positioned centrally on a flat, light brown surface, with the leaves and flowers extending above it against a plain beige background. The surface below the pitcher is glossy and reflective, and the pitcher casts a light brown shadow.

artworks.title: Shoe, Herring, and Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a dark-colored shoe on top of a stack of books. One of the books is partially covered in a multicolored, textured fabric with earthy tones of brown, beige, green, blue, and black. The shoe is placed horizontally on the books, angled towards the upper right corner. The books are aligned parallel to the bottom edge of the frame, with the fabric extending from beneath the shoe down towards the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Rosasharn
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts

artworks.title: View of Giverny
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a view from near a wooden fence overlooking a small village nestled below hills. The village includes buildings with pointed roofs and a church with a steeple. Delicate and sketchy brushstrokes and pencil strokes create a sense of lightness. The drawing is in a subtle monochrome palette on warm, neutral-toned paper.

artworks.title: Still Life with Fruit
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a group of fruits including grapes, apples, and pears placed on a flat surface. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, as the drawing is done in a pencil or charcoal sketch style, with shades of gray on a cream-colored paper. Positioned in the center-left of the image, the grapes spill over and touch the left edge, while the apples and pears are in the middle, extending towards the center-right. Leaves and branches are visible among the fruits, adding detail to their arrangement.

artworks.title: The East Prospect of the City of Philadelphia, in the Province of Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of Philadelphia viewed from an elevated position across water. The horizon line includes small hills and a skyline with buildings, including church spires. The print is in black and white with a historical feel. Ships with sails are on the water, some moving and others still. The cityscape is dense with buildings under a cloud-filled sky. Inset illustrations feature the State House and the Battery.

artworks.title: A Peach
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: A peach is placed on a flat surface. The peach is colored in shades of pink, orange, yellow, and subtle purples. The background is a dark brown tone. The peach is slightly left of center, casting a shadow towards the lower right.

artworks.title: The Wreck of the "Atlantic" - Cast Up by the Sea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a shoreline scene. The illustration shows a rocky coastal landscape with a figure lying motionless on the rocks near the water. Above, another figure stands with a somber expression, observing the scene. In the background, a partly sunken ship can be seen off the distant coastline. The setting is dramatic, with rough seas crashing against cliffs and the remnants of human tragedy evident on the shore. The etching lines and shading convey a tumultuous atmosphere, highlighting the seriousness of the scene.

artworks.title: Man in Snow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person lying on the ground with one arm raised, positioned near a barren tree against a cloudy backdrop. The image is rendered in pencil. The figure is reclining slightly on the ground with one arm bent behind the head, while the other arm is raised skyward. The barren tree on the left is contorted, its branches reaching upwards. The background consists of sweeping lines suggesting a cloudy or misty sky. The paper shows signs of wear, with its edges slightly frayed and toned.

artworks.title: Study for "The Freshet"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The drawing shows a group of individuals gathered by a river or body of water. There are outlines of figures engaged in various activities. Above them are suggestions of animals standing amongst rocky formations. The scene conveys movement and activity, with figures sitting, standing, and interacting with each other in a natural setting. The lines are light and sketchy, providing a loose yet intricate depiction of the scene.

artworks.title: Hollyhocks in a Long-necked Vase
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image features a glass vase with a delicate arrangement of flowers. The illustration is in black and white with varying shades of dark and light. The vase is at the bottom center, with flowers extending upwards. The detailed etching shows tightly clustered blooms and elongated stems with smaller buds in the center of the artwork.

artworks.title: Pansies
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed depiction of an orchid and a viola placed in the center of a rectangular frame with a lace-like border. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing the depth of the petals. The orchid is centrally positioned with shaded petals, while the viola is placed slightly behind on the right. The surrounding space is blank, with the artwork framed in the middle of the page.

artworks.title: Pansies
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows two large flowers in the center. The flower on the left is slightly larger and overlaps the one on the right. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from off-white to dark brown. The flowers are drawn with detailed lines, and their petals spread outward occupying the majority of the image space.

artworks.title: Dark Single Hollyhocks
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image displays large flowers in a monochromatic color palette of dark brown to light beige. The flowers are positioned vertically at the center, with smaller buds and leaves scattered among them for added texture and depth.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.artist: Russell Smith and Mary Wilson Smith
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: A tall building is depicted with a partially shadowed facade. A conical ink pot with a quill stand is prominently featured in the image. The building is painted in shades of blue with reddish-brown accents on the rooftop and details, while the ink pot has brown tones. The color palette includes muted blues and browns, along with beige and a small orange-red sphere. The building occupies the left side of the image vertically, while the ink pot and quill are on the right side, with a red sphere nearby at the bottom right corner. Faint sketches and outlines are visible in other areas of the background.

artworks.title: Shells, Watch Hill, Rhode Island
artworks.medium: black and gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows several large seashells, including a conch and a mussel shell, in the foreground. The color scheme is primarily brown and black. In the background, two sailboats can be seen on the horizon to the right side.

artworks.title: Man in Oriental Costume
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in three-quarter length view, kneeling on one knee with the other leg bent. The person is in a dynamic position, with one arm extended outward and the other hand placed over their chest. They have facial features including a mustache and wear a turban. The individual is dressed in loose, flowing garments, including a robe and pants. The background is a uniform, textured brown, with a vertical seam or crease visible. There are portions of text below the depiction, though difficult to read.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: watercolor on ivory paper in metal locket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a small portrait of a man, capturing his upper body from the chest up. The man is facing the viewer with a slight turn to his right. He has soft facial features, white wavy hair with curls around his ears and forehead, and a fair complexion. He is wearing a dark blue jacket with gold buttons and a high white cravat. The portrait is framed in gold, oval-shaped with a small metal loop at the top. The background features a soft gradient of brown and grey tones.

artworks.title: Nile Journey
artworks.medium: colored chalk on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard Spear and Athena Tacha
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon slightly below the middle. In the foreground, there is a figure standing next to a camel on gently sloping terrain. Sparse trees with thin branches are on the right. The brushstrokes are soft and sketch-like, conveying texture and movement. The color palette is muted with blues, greys, and browns blending harmoniously.
